purpose: Decide whether the approved exact after scene should be processed solely to test a candidly labeled local partial before/after visual map after the first scene failed full-area pixel QA.

exact_after_source.method_unchanged: Copernicus DEM, gamma0 power, 10 m, no speckle filter, no DEM matching, VV/VH and optional support layers

single_conditional_envelope_if_approved: Publish this exact packet and one owner decision to public default-branch CI. Continue through implementation, generated-data and installed ArcGIS synthetic tests, source-rights check, public CI, and fresh no-content preflight without intermediate owner reconfirmation.

Require a fresh free Basic credit check and exact M1-SRC-005 job validation through one secret-safe owner-controlled handoff. Stop on changed terms, insufficient free credits, any paid path, identity drift, or an indeterminate account response. Never store or print credentials.

Submit at most one exact RTC_GAMMA job for M1-SRC-005, with no automatic retry. On success, acquire its one exact ZIP once into append-only non-Git custody, verify size/hash/CRC and exact source/job/package identity, and preserve README, log, XML, product credits, DOI, and rights evidence.

After distinct implementation, public CI, and no-content gates, inspect only the after product's exact GeoTIFF headers and the two event AOIs' VV/VH/layover-shadow pixels under the unchanged product-specific exclusions. Preserve a separate after-source QA disposition even if it defers.

Only if both dates have at least 0.20 common valid VV/VH area in each event AOI, no undocumented mask classes, matching projected 10 m grids, and resolved image-display rights, create one local EPSG:32645 ArcGIS Pro side-by-side panel. Show true dates, extent of valid coverage and excluded layover/shadow/NoData, exact ASF/ESA credits and DOIs, and a conspicuous partial-data and unverified-registration warning. Display positive gamma0 power as 10*log10(power) dB only; no difference or swipe layer.

Reopen and export the local project and panel in a fresh ArcGIS process. Keep source and derived rasters, APRX and exports in non-Git custody. Publish only sanitized terminal receipts and exact public CI reconciliation. Stop on any gate, processing, rights, overlap, or export failure without automatic retry.

hard_limits.after_job_cost: free Basic credits only; no purchase or paid overflow

decision_requested: Approve, revise, or defer this single conditional visual-only partial-pair envelope. Approval would explicitly amend the first-source stop rule only for one exact M1-SRC-005 job and a conditional local partial-data panel, while preserving all full-QA and scientific restrictions.
